blocks.html: Reverted the Divine Light curve window while Zealous to 0.6s (was 0.8s)
Reverted the Divine Light curve window when non-Zealous
Dev note: The Judgment's performance skyrocketed following HF2. We are reverting the changes to Divine Light in order to better evaluate Its performance over a longer period of time.
We are making a game update to address the growing issue around The Judgment. This will not require a download of any new content, however players will need to restart their game.
Features
Survivor Intent System
Survivors can send and receive text messages during a match
By pressing and holding the scroll-button when using a Mouse, or the right d-pad input on controllers, players can open the messages wheel
8 messages are available for players to select and send
Hovering the message, and releasing scroll-button/right, will send the message
Inputs are customizable
Sent messages are shown to all Survivors, next to their information on the left side of the screen
Messages are predefined.
Players can customize on Settings their messages selection
On Match Details, Players can mute and unmute any other player during a match
Muting is not communicated to the muted player
On Settings, players can deactivate the system, if they want to opt out
On Match Details, Players that have deactivated the system are marked with a "no" icon to surface that they have opt out
For reducing spamming, a 1s cooldown is applied when players send messages too quickly.
If a player keeps spamming, their cooldown will increase up to 5 seconds.
Waiting before sending new messages will reset the cooldown to its shortest duration.
The "Gameplay" section has been added to Settings.
The options for the system are on the Gameplay Tab, under "Messages"
Abandon, Surrender, End Trial
Abandon Option
Survivor Condition - When all other Survivors are bots, the remaining human Survivor gains the option to Abandon
Survivor is considered Abandoned
Killer Condition - When all remaining Survivors are bots, and at least 1 is not in the Dying State, the Killer gains the option to Abandon (new condition)
Killer is considered Abandoned
Survivor outcome depends on what state they were in when the Killer Abandoned
Surrender Option
Survivor Condition - When all the Survivors are in the Dying State simultaneously, Survivors gain the option to Surrender (previously Abandon)
Survivors are considered Surrendered
End Trial Option
Killer Condition - When all remaining Survivors are bots, and in the Dying State, the Killer gains the option to End Trial (new condition)
Survivor outcome depends on what state they were in when the Killer Ends Trial
Dev Notes:
Intentions are as follows:
Options to leave result in clearer outcomes for both roles
Remove problematic conditions that encourage negative gameplay behaviour
Lower the frequency of players leaving an ongoing match
Content
Killer Perk Updates
Agitation
While carrying a Survivor:
Your Terror Radius is 12m larger.
Iron Grasp
While carrying a Survivor:
Their wiggle is 75% weaker.
They wiggle 10/11/12% slower. (was 4/8/12%)
Dev Note: We want to modernize the lower tier values of a few older perks to make them feel closer to what new players can expect long term.
Bitter Murmur
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within 20m of it for 8s. (was 16m and 5s)
When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 10/12/14s. (was 5/7/10s)
Deerstalker
Every 40/35/30s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for 4s. (was 3s)
While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.
Fire Up
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.
For each Token:
You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls 6/7/8% faster. (was 4/5/6%)
You damage Generators 6/7/8% faster. (was 4/5/6%)
You pick-up and drop Survivors 6/7/8% faster. (was 4/5/6%)
You basic-vault Windows 6/7/8% faster. (was 4/5/6%)
Game Afoot
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damage a Generator, you gain 10% Haste for 8/9/10s. (was 7%)
Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.
Spies from the Shadows
Whenever a Survivor scares a Crow within 36/38/40m of you, you are alerted. Cooldown 3s. (was 20/28/36m and 5s)
Unbound
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next 26/28/30s, whenever you basic-vault a window, you gain 5% Haste for 25s. (was 24/27/30s and 7% Haste for 10s)
Dev Note: Number improvements to Generic perks and perks impacted by Diminishing Returns.
Help Wanted
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.
When that Generator is completed by Survivors:
Your successful basic-attack cooldowns are 25% shorter for 100/110/120s (was 40/50/60s)
Generators not being repaired regress at 150% speed for 100/110/120s (NEW)
Other Generators lose compromised. (NEW)
Up to 3 Generators can be compromised at a time. (was 1 Generator)
Machine Learning
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.
When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:
You gain 10% Haste for 40/50/60s (was 8%)
You gain Undetectable for 40/50/60s
Other Generators lose compromised. (NEW)
Up to 3 Generators can be compromised at a time. (was 1 Generator)

Dev Note: Compromise perks require precise setup and the loss of a Generator. We weren't entirely happy with exactly how precise, being able to compromise 3 Generators should allow for a bit more flexibility in how they're activated. While improving the bonuses they provide aims to make the work feel worthwhile.
Dark Arrogance
You basic-vault Windows 15/20/25% faster.
Your basic-attack recovery is 15/20/25% faster. (NEW)
Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is 25% longer. (was 15%)
Dev Note: We found the downside of this perk to be very thematic but felt the bonus gained in return lacking. We want it to feel like a worthwhile trade-off.
Dead Man's Switch

When you hook a Survivor, the first time a Survivor stops repairing a Generator for more than 2s, it is blocked for 30/35/40s. Cooldown: 30/35/40s. (was when a Survivor instantly stopped repairing a Generator, and 25/30/35s block duration and 50s cooldown)

Dev Note: We found the combination of Dead Man's Switch with effects that caused brief forced interruptions lead to uninteractive moments. However we like the effect provided by Dead Man's Switch, when a Killer actively pressures Survivors off of Generators.
Dissolution
3s after a Survivor takes damage from a basic-attack, for 13/14/15s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed. (was any damage and 12/16/20s)
Hex: Blood Favor
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured by your basic-attack, Upright Pallets within 32m of them are blocked for 13/14/15s. (was any damage and 24/28/32m and 15s)

Dev Note: We found the combination of Dissolution or Blood Favor and Killers that can use their power to quickly get an injury to be unhealthy. Additionally Blood Favor while strong in chase also happened to have the secondary benefit of denying pallet saves.
Distressing
Survivors within your Terror Radius repair 6/7/8% slower. (NEW)
Your Terror Radius is 30% larger. (was 20/23/30%)

Dev Note: Distressing not providing a tangible benefit outside of a Terror Radius change can make it not feel like a real option outside of very specific builds. We've added a dedicated slow down effect to give a reason to select it on it's own. It's a simple passive slow down aimed primarily at newer players who've yet to unlock some of the better slow down options.
Dominance
The first time each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor: (was Totems and Chests)
It is blocked for 25s. (was 8/12/16s)
That Survivor screams. (NEW)
You see their Aura for 3/4/5s. (NEW)

Dev Note: We didn't like that this perk inadvertently punished players for opening chests, as it was primarily intended as a totem defense perk. Currently Dominance can be quite hard to keep track of as your Totems silently become blocked. We want to give you extra information on who knows your totem is there, and where they're running off too afterwards.
Hex: Nothing but Misery
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack 4 times, a Dull Totem ignites. (was 8 times)
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack:
They gain 5% Hindered for 10/12.5/15s.
They vault 10% slower for 10/12.5/15s (NEW)

Dev Note: We found that the hex took too long to get for the benefit that it provided. We've reduced the overall requirement so it should come into play earlier in a trial. To further encourage Survivors to cleanse the totem, we've added a vault speed reduction. Previously with perks we've only ever increased vault speed so we're keeping a close eye on this one to see how it lands.
Hex: Thrill of the Hunt (Rework)
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.
When you hook a Survivor, block all Hex Totems for 6/7/8s for each lit Hex Totem.

Dev Note: We found Thrill of the Hunt created strong passive value. Requiring very little work from the Killer to reset a large amount of progress from the Survivor. Our intention with the rework is to maintain the perks defensive capability but in a much more active way.
Insidious
After being idle for 2s, you gain Undetectable. (was 3/2/1s)
Whenever you act, this ends after 6/7/8s. (NEW)

Dev Note: Outside of basement dwellers and Hallucination imposters Insidious has struggled to find it's place in the fog. We found it's effect iconic, but lacking. The intention behind the linger is to provide more opportunities to mind game certain areas.
Knock Out
Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next 6s, if they move 10m away from it, they gain 20% Hindered for 3/4/5s. (was 6m and 5%)
This ends early if the Pallet is broken. (NEW)

Dev Note: We want Knock Out to feel impactful in those cases where Survivors don't loop around pallets. We've increased the range to account for some longer loops, as this should only impact players who intentionally run away from a pallet. We've also updated the removal effect to now also end the Hindered early if the pallet get's broken, even if it's already been applied.
Ravenous
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token. For each token:
Gain 4% Haste while carrying Survivors. (NEW)
Hook Survivors 4% faster. (NEW)
When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors:
Scream.
Gain Exposed for 80/85/90s. (was 40/50/60s)

Dev Note: Hooking each Survivor once can be a difficult task. We want the reward to feel impactful, adding extra duration to the Exposed status allows more time to find and down Survivors. We also want to reward the player for each token to better encourage reaching all four. A hooking efficiency improvement should help you get back into the action faster.
Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
When the trial starts:
4 random hooks become Scourge Hooks.
The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, Generators not being repaired regress at 150/175/200% speed. (NEW)

Dev Note: Monstrous Shrine benefited players for not camping by applying more pressure to Survivors but it's effect was rarely felt. We want Monstrous Shrine to encourage players to seek out other Survivors and chase them off Generators to gain the strong benefit of faster regression. We also want the Survivors to have to make the choice between leaving the the Survivor on the safety of the hook, or rescuing them to end the regression effect.
Shattered Hope (Rework)
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem, it is destroyed.
Whenever a Totem is blessed, cleansed or destroyed: (NEW)
Dull Totems are blocked for 16/18/20s. (NEW)
Hex Totems are blocked for 16/18/20s. (NEW)
You see the Auras of Boon Totems for 16/18/20s. (NEW)

Dev Note: We are actively discussing how we want Boon Totem snuffing to work base-kit. In the meantime the other effect of Shattered Hope was very limited to only providing value if boons were used. We want Shattered Hope to provide direct value that you could bring alongside Hex builds.
Superior Anatomy

Whenever a Survivor medium or fast-vaults within 12m of you, the next time you basic-vault a Window, you basic-vault Windows 30/35/40% faster for 10s. Cooldown: 20s. (was basic-vault once faster and 25s cooldown)

Dev Note: We want to provide more flexibility to Superior Anatomy's usage. For those players who like to double or even triple vault a window the effect will now linger after it's been used. Due to the cooldown being delayed until after the linger we've reduced it slightly so it doesn't feel like a nerf in situations where you only need to vault once.
Undone (Rework)
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn 1 tokens, up to 3.
Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all tokens. For each token spent:
The Generator loses 8/9/10% progress.
The Generator is blocked for 8/9/10s.

Dev Note: We found that Undone only really punished Survivors who were already struggling. We've put the activation condition in the Killers hands, giving them more agency. Less instant regression than Pop Goes the Weasel but the flexibility to stack it can lead to strategic moments. The generator still begins regressing when it's unblocked.
Unrelenting
Your missed basic-attack cooldown is 30/35/40% shorter. (was 20/25/30%)
Your successful basic-attack cooldown is 10% shorter. (NEW)

Dev Note: Diminishing Returns allows us to return the long since removed successful basic-attack cooldown. Additionally for cases where you're smacking a lock off a locker or hitting a pallet instead of a player. This perk now also includes obstructed basic-attack.
Whispers
While within 28/26/24m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers. (was 48/40/32m)
While outside of 28/26/24m of a Survivor, you gain 5% Haste. (NEW)

Dev Note: We want to give Whispers a new benefit to distinguish itself from being exclusively about information. The intention behind the added Haste is to help better traverse the map while looking for Survivors. While the reduced range is to allow more opportunities for the Killer to gain Haste.
Survivor Perk Updates
Kindred
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within 14/15/16m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura. (was 8/12/16m)
While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within 14/15/16m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura. (was 8/12/16m)
No One Left Behind
When all Generators are completed:
You unhook other Survivors 80/90/100% faster. (was 50/75/100%)
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, they gain 10% more Haste.
You see the Auras of other Survivors.
Resilience
While injured:
You bless and cleanse Totems 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
You heal 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
You open Exit Gates 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
You repair 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
You sabotage Hooks 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
You unhook Survivors 7/8/9% fester. (was 3/6/9%)
You unlock chests 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
You vault 7/8/9% faster. (was 3/6/9%)
We'll Make It
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, for 70/80/90s, you heal other Survivors 100% faster. (was 30/60/90s)
Dev Note: We want to modernize the lower tier values of a few older perks to make them feel closer to what new players can expect long term.
Better Than New
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage:
They bless and cleanse 40/45/50% faster. (was 12/14/16%)
They heal 40/45/50% faster. (was 12/14/16%)
They unlock Chests 40/45/50% faster. (was 12/14/16%)
Empathic Connection
You heal other Survivors 40/45/50% faster. (was 25/30/35%)
Injured Survivors see your Aura.
Flow State
Whenever a generator is completed, earn 1 token, up to 5.
For each token:
You bless and cleanse Totems 13/14/15% faster. (was 8/9/10%)
You heal 13/14/15% faster. (was 8/9/10%)
You unhook Survivors 13/14/15% faster. (was 8/9/10%)
Friendly Competition
Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair 10% faster for 80/85/90s. (was 5% for 100/110/120s)
Bound by Obsession \
While you are the Obsession, every 30s, the Killer sees your Aura for 4s. (was 3s)
While the Killer sees your Aura:
You see their Aura.
You bless and cleanse Totems 8/9/10% faster. (was only cleanse and 2/4/6%)
You heal 8/9/10% faster. (was 2/4/6%)
You repair 8/9/10% faster. (was 2/4/6%)
When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
Dev Note: Number improvements to Generic perks and perks impacted by Diminishing Returns.
Blood Pact
While you are not the Obsession:
While you or the Obsession is injured, you see each other's Auras.
Whenever you finish healing the Obsession or they finish healing you, while within 16m of each other, you both gain 5/6/7% Haste.
While you are the Obsession if you are hooked another Survivor becomes the Obsession. (NEW)
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

Dev Note: Blood Pact's ability to combine with other perks has been reduced since Diminishing Returns however we are happy with it's current Haste value. Instead we want to provide a quality of life improvement in an era where several perks are changing who the Obsession is.
Boon: Illumination
While next to a Totem, use Active Ability Button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.
Survivors within the Boon's range:
See the Auras of Chests.
See the Auras of Generators.
While you have a Boon Totem, you bless 150/175/200% faster. (was bless and cleanse 6/8/10%)

Dev Note: We want Boon: Illumination to feel more like a support boon you can bring to more easily transfer your boon around as the trial progresses. It also makes blessing a Hex Totem faster than cleansing it (equivalent to approx. 35% increased cleanse speed)
Borrowed Time (Rework)
Whenever you gain Deep Wound while you have Endurance passively mend over 40/35/30s.

Dev Note: We added Elusive to the list of unhook protections previously but didn't like the idea of Borrowed Time extending it's duration. Instead we've opted to rework the perk to an entirely new effect.
Calm Spirit
You do not scare Crows or scream.
You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently and 8/9/10% faster. (was 40/35/30% slower)

Dev Note: We do not feel like Calm Spirit needs the downside, instead we've flipped it to providing a subtle upside. The intention being you should still primarily be taking this perk for it's scream and crow prevention.
Dark Sense
Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within 24m of you, for 8/9/10s: (was 5/7/10s)
You see the Aura of Pallets and Windows within 24m (NEW)
You see the Auras of other Survivors. (NEW)
You see the Killer's Aura.

Dev Note: We want to maintain the simplicity of the perk. The intent behind the new benefits is both to give new players a tool to learn maps and teach them to position themselves near resources as the Killer approaches.
Down to the Last \ (Rework)
Whenever you are hooked or complete a generator, you earn 1 Token, up to 6.
For each Token, other Survivors open Exit Gates 10% faster.
When you are the last Survivor, if you have at least 3 Tokens:
You can unlock the Hatch.
For each Token, the Killer cannot see your Aura for 6/8/10s.

Dev Note: We found Sole Survivor to be a selfish perk, often to the detriment of the other Survivors. We want to maintain the final girl aspects while shifting it's focus more to supporting your teammates. Swapping the activation condition to encourage the user to engage in the normal gameplay loop. Providing the Exit Gate bonus to other Survivors encourages them to escape, so that the player who brought Sole Survivor can escape through the Hatch.
Do No Harm
While healing another Survivor for each Hook State they have:
You heal 30/40/50% faster.
Great basic Skill Check, grant 3% more progress. (was separate from the Hook State)
Increase the odds of triggering a Skill Check by 5%. (NEW)

Dev Note: We want Do No Harm to better distinguish itself from other flat healing speed perks. We added a scaling increase Skill Check odds and made the great skill check bonus scale as well. It should find a home with Survivors who like skill checks and skill check perks.
Five Moves Ahead
While you are in the Killer's Terror radius or chased by the Killer:
You see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets. (was Pallets and Windows)
After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier.
Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: 40/35/30s.
Dev Note: Following the change to Windows of Opportunity below, we want to make Five Moves Ahead specialize in Pallets.
Pharmacy
Whenever you unlock a Chest, it will contain a rare Med-Kit.
You unlock and rummage Chests 75/100/125% faster. (was only unlock)
You can rummage each Chest 1 time. (NEW)
The range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is 12m shorter.

Dev Note: Bringing Pharmacy without other perks meant you were forgoing the option to ever find other items when you needed them. We want Pharmacy to still allow for the flexibility of finding the other item types by rummaging.
Plunderer's Instinct
You see the aura of Chests and Items. (was only within 32/48/64m)
You unlock chests 150%/175%/200% faster. (NEW)
Whenever you unlock a Chest you are 50% more likely to find an item of higher rarity.
Dev Note: We want Plunderer's Instinct to be your go to for improving the efficiency of interacting with Chests. It should have it's place in builds that require you to open Chests.
Premonition (Rework)
While not chased by the Killer, whenever you look in the Killer’s direction within 32m: (was 36m and within 45 degrees)
You are notified.
You see the Killer's Aura for 3s. (NEW)

Dev Note: We want to modernize this perk by providing an Aura, giving newer players more direct information. To reinforce the need for players to learn how to loop a tile the effect disables in chase.
Road Life (Rework)
While injured and repairing a Generator: (was injured and not broken)
Whenever you hit a basic great Skill Check, you earn 1 Token.
Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 1 Token.
When you have 6/5/4 Tokens, you can heal yourself. Spend all Tokens to heal yourself 100% faster. (now grants the ability to self-heal)
When you stop healing, this ends after 4s. (NEW)

Dev Note: We want Road Life to be more usable on it's own so we've given it the ability to self-heal and removed the broken restriction. We also added a quality of life linger so when a heal is interrupted accidentally it's effect isn't instantly cancelled.
Self-Preservation
Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain Elusive for 13/14/15s. (was 20/25/30s)

Dev Note: We know that Elusive can be a strong status effect. Several Self Preservations in a lobby can have the unintended effect of the Killer returning back to hook more often. We're reducing the numbers here quite a bit, but are keeping a close eye on this perk.
Shoulder the Burden
Once per trial, while you do not have 2 Hook States, are next to a hooked Survivor use Active Ability Button 2 to unhook them:
They lose 1 Hook State.
You gain 1 Hook State.
You scream.
You become Injured (was Exposed for 60/50/40s)
You become Broken for 160/140/120s. (NEW)
Shoulder the Burden is deactivated for all Survivors. (NEW)

Dev Note: Shoulder the Burden's incredibly strong effect has not had a sizeable enough downside. We also found that the flexibility of how Shoulder the Burden could be used left little options for counterplay. We still fully expect the perk to be strong in the right hands. However we feel the new downsides and limitation provides more avenues for counterplay. We still aren't completely happy with it's interactions with some other perks, and are keeping a close eye on how the changes are received.
Slippery Meat (Rework)
Other Survivors unhook you 90/95/100% faster.
Whenever you are unhooked, you gain 5% more Haste.

Dev Note: Slippery Meat was only ever effective with full Luck stacking, which lead to unhealthy situations. The intent behind this rework is for Slippery Meat to be a simple and useful form of General anti-tunnel. It's not expected to fully eclipse existing anti-tunnel but be present as an option for newer players.
Small Game (Rework)
Within 10/11/12m of a Totem, you see its Aura.
Dev Note: We found trying to aim an invisible cone was confusing, especially for newer players. We want the new effect to be a very simple one, aimed at helping new players learn Totem locations.
Solidarity
While injured and healing another Survivor you also gain healing progress at 65/70/75% speed. (was without a Med-Kit and 50/60/70%)
Dev Note: We removed the restriction that prevented using Solidarity with a Med-Kit to encourage more altruistic usage of Med-Kits.
Spine Chill (Rework)
Whenever the Killer looks at you within 40m:
You are notified.
You cannot scream for 12s.
You vault 10% faster for 12s.
Cooldown: 40/35/30s

Dev Note: Return of vault speed Spine Chill, now with a limited duration! We're keeping a close eye on this one as we know vault speed is a strong effect, but feel like Diminishing Returns is a good opportunity to explore it once again.
Stake Out (Rework)
After hiding for 15s within 24m of the Killer, while in their Terror Radius, you earn 1 Token, up to 2/3/4.
While you have at least 1 Token, basic Skill Checks are replaced by special Skill Checks.
Special Skill Checks grant +4% more progress.
Whenever you miss a special Skill Check, lose -4% more progress.
Whenever you hit or miss a special Skill Check, spend 1 Token.

Dev Note: Previously Stake Out put a limitation on design space, removing any difficulty from great Skill Checks. We instead want to give players who are looking for the extra challenge more risk and reward from their skill checks. The Special Skill Check is more difficult and no longer activates other Skill Check perks.
This is Not Happening
Good basic Skill Check zones are 150/175/200% bigger. (NEW)
Great basic Skill Check zones are 30% bigger. (was while injured and 10/20/30%)

Dev Note: We want this perk to be simple and aimed at newer players, however the injured requirement felt counter to these goals. Only impacting the great zone always meant it's numbers could never be too high due to other perks. Adding the good zone let's us greatly improve the numbers, to better match the intent of a simple perk for new players.
Wake Up!
When all Generators are completed:
You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura.
You open Exit Gates 8/9/10% faster, and an additional 20% faster for each other Survivor alive. (was 8/10/12.5% per any Survivor alive)

Dev Note: We want to improve the Exit Gate opening speed provided by other Survivors. Splitting the bonus between yourself and other Survivors allows us to more precisely balance around our intention of altruistic end game perks. Alone the perk is 2.5% slower than before, and if all Survivors are alive the perk is 20% faster than before.
Windows of Opportunity (Rework)
Within 24m of you see the Auras of Windows.
You vault Windows 10% faster.
Whenever you vault a Window, cooldown: 40/35/30s.

Dev Note: Windows of Opportunity has long reigned as one of the most used perks for it's universal visibility on resources. We feel especially with the inclusion of other options it's a good opportunity to make it specialize in Windows. Players can still gain the old effects of Windows of Opportunity by using the new Dark Sense or combining Windows of Opportunity with Five Moves Ahead.
Bug Fixes
Audio
Fixed an issue where Curios item are missing their interaction SFX.
Bot Improvements
Tentative fix for Survivor Bots sometimes automatically revealing Ghostface from anywhere on the map
Fixed an issue where Survivor Bots tried to force a Flashlight save for too long against the Lightborn perk.
Characters
Fixed an issue where using The Pig's Ambush power while pointing the camera downward caused the camera to clip into the ground and the Killer's arm to appear distorted.
Fixed an issue where The Mastermind lacked downward acceleration when falling from a vault from a higher location with Virulent Bound.
Fixed an issue where The Mastermind would sometimes collide with ground geometry when using Virulent Bound.
Fixed an issue where The Twins' Charlotte was unable to see the Aura of Exit Gates if the last Generator was completed while controlling Victor.
Fixed an issue where the Aura of the Exit Gates was missing while in The Knight's Summoning Phase.
Environment/Maps
Fixed an issue in Greenville Square where a collision is preventing players from navigating properly
Fixed an issue in Crotus Prenn Asylum where The Houndmaster's dog could not vault over the window of the shack from the exterior side
Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where the survivors were not able to heal each others in the stairs of the main structure
Fixed an issue in Freddy Fazzbear's Pizza map where a maze tile didn't spawn the window and pallets

POWER: WILL OF THE GODS
DIVINE LIGHT
Press and hold the Power Button to summon Divine Light for up to 3s.
Divine Light moves away from The Judgment and is controlled with camera controls (left/right only).
While in this state, Divine Light does not damage Survivors.
If Divine Light passes through obstacles, it slows down.
While controlling Divine Light, press the Attack Button to Cast it forward.

When Cast, it enters a brief delay before it fully activates, damaging and applying Heresy to any Survivors hit. (Survivors inflicted with Heresy are known as Heretics) Dev note: Divine Light enters its lethal state when it becomes larger.
When cast Divine Light is lethal and if misses a Survivor by 0.5m, reveal them with Killer Instinct for 2s
The longer Divine Light is controlled:
The shorter the Cast delay
The longer the Cast duration
Divine Light has a 6 second cooldown. Dev note: Divine Light's delay phase duration starts at 0.9s, after controlling Divine Light for 1s, the delay reaches its minimum of 0.3s
ZEALOUS
Press the Secondary Ability Button to Exile a Heretic in the Dying State, gaining Zealous. (If they have 2 Hook States, they are killed instead.)
Exiling a Survivor gives them a Hook State.
When Exiling a Heretic:
The 2 closest Shrines of Judgment become Active
Zealous lasts for 60 seconds.
Gain Killer Instinct on all Heretics for 3s. (only applies to Survivors with full Heresy)
While Zealous:
Increase Divine Light's size by 10%
Decrease Divine Light's cooldown by 20%
Maintain control of Divine Light for up to 0.3s
EXILE
Exile acts like a Hook, but does not trigger Hook-related perks.
Upon entering Exile, Survivors receive a Searcher's Pendant (Limited Item).
Exile is filled with dangerous Seeds of Punishment that reduce a Survivor's Sacrifice timer by 3s when hit.
Exile is also filled with helpful Exiled Souls. Hold the Use Item button to point the Searcher's Pendant at Exiled Souls to collect them.
For each Exiled Soul collected (up to 10), Survivors gain an additional 0.5s to default Unhook Protections (10% Haste, Endurance, and Elusive).
Exiled Souls no longer grant additional protections once all Generators are completed.
Survivors who aren't in Exile can Pray at an active Shrine of Judgment (highlighted in red) to rescue Exiled Survivors.
HERESY
Heresy is gained when hit by Divine Light or by taunting The Judgment (crouching repeatedly, gesturing or lingering in the Exit Area... just leave)
Heretics suffer from special Skill Checks while repairing Generators. Good Skill Check results cause the Generator to lose some progression.
Heretics can Repent at a Shrine of Judgment to begin depleting their Heresy over time.

Features
New Killer: The Judgment
POWER: WILL OF THE GODS
DIVINE LIGHT
Press and hold the Power Button (M2) to summon Divine Light for up to 3s.
Divine Light moves away from The Judgment and is controlled with camera controls (left/right only).
While in this state, Divine Light does not damage Survivors.
If Divine Light passes through obstacles, it slows down.
While controlling Divine Light, press the Attack Button (M1) to Cast it forward.
When cast, it enters a brief delay before it fully activates, damaging and applying Heresy to any Survivors hit. (Survivors inflicted with Heresy are known as Heretics)
The longer Divine Light is controlled:
The shorter the Cast delay
The longer the Cast duration
Divine Light has a 6 second cooldown.
ZEALOUS
Press the Secondary Ability Button (LCTRL) to Exile a Heretic in the Dying State, gaining Zealous. (If they have 2 Hook States, they are killed instead.)
Exiling a Survivor gives them a Hook State.
When Exiling a Heretic:
The 2 closest Shrines of Judgment become Active
Zealous lasts for 60 seconds.
Gain Killer Instinct on all Heretics for 3s. (only applies to Survivors with full Heresy)
While Zealous:
Increase Divine Light's size by 10%
Decrease Divine Light's cooldown by 20%
Maintain control of Divine Light for up to 0.3s (the longer it is controlled before being cast, the lower it will be, starting at 1s)
EXILE
Exile acts like a Hook, but does not trigger Hook-related perks.
Upon entering Exile, Survivors receive a Searcher's Pendant (Limited Item).
Exile is filled with dangerous Seeds of Punishment that reduce a Survivor's Sacrifice timer by 1s when hit.
Exile is also filled with helpful Exiled Souls. Hold the Use Item button (M2) to point the Searcher's Pendant at Exiled Souls to collect them.
For each Exiled Soul collected (up to 10), Survivors gain an additional 0.5s to default Unhook Protections (10% Haste, Endurance, and Elusive).
Exiled Souls no longer grant additional protections once all Generators are completed.
Survivors who aren't in Exile can Pray at an active Shrine of Judgment (highlighted in red) to rescue Exiled Survivors.
HERESY
Heresy is gained when hit by Divine Light or by taunting The Judgment (crouching repeatedly, gesturing or lingering in the Exit Area... just leave)
Heretics suffer from special Skill Checks while repairing Generators. Good Skill Check results cause the Generator to lose some progression.
Heretics can Repent at a Shrine of Judgment to begin depleting their Heresy over time.

NEW KILLER: THE SLASHER
POWER: OMNIPRESENT EVIL

Press the Active Ability button to activate Omnipresent Evil. The Slasher becomes invisible and gains Undetectable, but cannot see Survivors or their Scratch Marks. Mist Clouds reveal the location of Survivors who are not moving. Footprints reveal the path of Survivors who are walking or running.
Omnipresent Evil is deactivated by using Jump Scare.
SPECIAL ABILITY: JUMP SCARE

While Omnipresent Evil is activated, look at a Pallet, Breakable Wall, or Window to quickly move to it and perform a special-break or special-vault action. The Secondary Action button switches the side you will face when performing Jump Scare.
Jump Scare exits Omnipresent Evil mode, grants Haste, and reveals detected Survivors with Killer Instinct.
SPECIAL ABILITY: THROWING SPIKES

Grab a Spike from Scrap Piles or Hooks. Hold the Secondary Action button to ready the Spike and tap the Attack button to throw. Spikes are replenished throughout the map when Omnipresent Evil is activated.
A Spike knocks back a Survivor and damages them for one health state.
Survivors will be Impaled if they are hit with a Hook Spike. They cannot heal past the injured state and the embedded Hook Spike will have an Aura visible to the Killer.
Injured Survivors will be both Impaled and Immobilized if they are hit with a Spike and knocked into a wall.

Features
Diminishing Returns Update
While in a Trial, repeated positive or negative gameplay modifiers and status effects are now affected by diminishing returns.
Identical Killer and Survivor modifiers granted by Powers, Items, Perks and Offerings will now be reduced progressively as they become stacked.
The following apply diminishing returns only within their role:
Negative action speed modifiers
Positive skill check chance modifiers
The following are excluded entirely from diminishing returns:
Modifiers granted from Add-ons
The gameplay modifier with the highest absolute value is always applied, while lesser ones are progressively lowered to a percentage of their original value.
The game prioritizes the highest values, reducing the impact of lesser ones.
1st value (highest) - 100% of modifier
2nd value - 50% of modifier
3rd value - 25% of modifier
4th value - 12.5% of modifier
5th value and up - 5% of modifier
Game manual updated to include information on diminishing returns.
1v4 Play While You Wait Update
Added the option to "Play While You Wait" to the default 1v4 game mode.
While searching for a match as Killer, you will receive the option to Play While You Wait.
This allows you to play a match as a Survivor while saving your place in the Killer queue.
After finishing your Survivor match, you will automatically be returned to your place in the Killer queue.

The color has been updated so it represents the speed of the interaction, becoming yellow if faster than normal, and red if slower than normal

Changes from PTB
Diminishing Returns Update
Following PTB, the following gameplay modifiers now apply diminishing returns only within their role:
Negative action speed modifiers
Positive skill check chance modifiers

Dev note: Thank you for your feedback during the 9.6.0 PTB period! Following reports, we have appended the diminishing returns system to exclude specific modifiers to maintain intended interactions. Notably, negative modifiers will now only apply within the same role. We discovered during PTB that negative modifiers from Killer and Survivor sources were reducing each other, causing self-inflicted penalties to be lessened and gameplay outcomes not working as intended.

On 9.6.0 PTB, for example, the self-inflicted 30% cleansing speed penalty from the Survivor Perk Calm Spirit was being reduced by 50% when calculated against the starting 60% cleansing speed penalty from the Killer Perk Hex: Thrill of the Hunt. Similarly, we found that positive modifiers for skill checks also needed this intervention. The Survivor Perk ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! was causing Killer Perks like Unnerving Presence to have their effects reduced, which caused skill checks less likely to appear than the intended total increase.
While this ultimately increases complexity, this change guarantees that Survivor and Killer modifiers from Loadouts always work as intended by Players selecting them.

Features
Diminishing Returns Update
While in a Trial, repeated positive or negative gameplay modifiers and status effects are now affected by diminishing returns.
Identical modifiers granted by Powers, Items, Perks and Offerings will now be reduced progressively as they become stacked.
Modifiers granted from Killer Power and Survivor Item add-ons are excluded from diminishing returns.
The gameplay modifier with the highest absolute value is always applied, while lesser ones are progressively lowered to a percentage of their original value
The game prioritizes the highest values, reducing the impact of lesser ones.
1st value (highest) - 100% of modifier
2nd value - 50% of modifier
3rd value - 25% of modifier
4th value - 12.5% of modifier
5th value and up - 5% of modifier

Dev note: After 10 years of Dead by Daylight, the ability of Killers and Survivors to stack modifiers indefinitely has enabled ever-accelerating and more intense gameplay. With this update, we aim to normalize how modifiers from different sources interact against each other in order to better preserve the integrity of game. All major gameplay modifiers and status effects for both roles are included in this update.

Additionally, this change will help us as developers create new interesting Powers, Items and Perks with our roster of existing game modifiers, with far less risk of creating unintended game-breaking scenarios.
We will be closely monitoring this change during the PTB and look forward to the feedback!

Killer Actions Update
Accompanying the new language found in the Perks Description Update (see below), we have expanded our distinction between basic and special actions performed by Killers.
Starting in update 9.5.0, the following terms will now appear in Power, Add-on and Perk descriptions:
Basic-break
When a Pallet or Breakable Wall is broken by the default ability of any Killer.
Special-break
When a Downed Pallet or Breakable Wall is broken due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power.
Basic-vault
When a Window is vaulted by the default ability of any Killer.
Special-vault
When a Window or Downed Pallet is vaulted due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power.
Damaging Generators
When a Generator is damaged and loses progress due to the default ability of any Killer.
Generator Explosions
When a Generator loses progress due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power or Perk.
With these new terms, we intend to express with increased accuracy when specific gameplay interactions are intended to work alongside one another.
Notably Killer Powers and Killer Perks.

Style Points
The Trickster performing combo actions generates Style Points.
A combo action is triggered when two back-to-back gameplay actions are distinct.
The following actions generate 1 Style Point:
Hitting a Survivor with a Blade (first-hit only).
Injuring a Survivor (from Laceration or basic-attack).
Hooking a Survivor.
Basic-breaking a Downed Pallet.
Basic-breaking a Breakable Wall.
Damaging a Generator.
Snuffing a Boon Totem.

The following actions generate 3 Style Points:

Style Ranks
There are 6 Style Ranks: E, D, C, B, A and S-Rank.
Style Ranks each have their respective bonus maximum throw rate and Locker restocking speed modifiers.
Higher bonuses at higher ranks.
Higher Style Ranks require more Style Points to reach.
Higher Style Ranks feature progressively shorter combo timers.
Ranks regress to previous in order if combo timer ever lapses.
Earning Style Points refreshes the current Style Rank's combo timer.
Style Rank combo timers are paused while The Trickster is performing interactions with Survivors or interactable objects.
